preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1 for a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the edges must be valid node indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of nodes selected to light up all edges.
